name: Shorsh

queries.query: Shorsh Iraq cadastral map parcel GIS official Kirkuk
queries.result: No Shorsh/Kirkuk-specific first-party parcel viewer or geometry service surfaced. Official Iraq Ministry of Justice and Iraq Geographic Portal leads were found.

queries.query: العراق شورش كركوك خريطة عقارية قطع اراضي GIS رسمي; کەرکووک شۆڕش نەخشە کاداستەر پارچە زەوی GIS
queries.result: Arabic results identified the official Ministry of Justice real-estate registration services and the Iraq Geographic Portal; Kurdish results did not identify a public Shorsh/Kirkuk parcel geometry service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Iraq has official real-estate registration and property-map procedures; no public citywide parcel geometry scope for Shorsh/Kirkuk was verified.

officialLeads.operator: Iraq Ministry of Justice / Real Estate Registration Department
officialLeads.observation: Official ministry notice describes electronic deed, property-map, property-statement and related services launched for named Baghdad registration directorates. It establishes the national registry custodian and service model, not Shorsh/Kirkuk anonymous geometry access.

Official portal page exposes Ministry of Construction/Housing/Municipalities services for state-land locations and registration-office distribution; no cadastral parcel polygon layer or query endpoint was advertised in the accessible page.

Official service description says a property owner may request a deed and property map from the responsible registration directorate. The page states electronic availability currently in Baghdad, with other directorates to follow; it is title-specific and not an anonymous citywide parcel feed.

officialLeads.operator: Kurdistan Regional Government services portal / Directorate of Land Registry
officialLeads.observation: Official procedure describes property-boundary demarcation, requiring owner/attorney documents and a registry copy; listed offices are in Erbil. It does not evidence a Kirkuk/Shorsh public map service and no authenticated or owner-specific route was attempted.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official ministry notice loaded; only service/procedure information, no parcel geometry response.
Official portal service page loaded. HTML exposed no public ArcGIS/WFS/GeoJSON parcel endpoint; only descriptive service links.
Direct request returned portal anti-automation response; public indexed service description was inspected. No retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or submission was attempted.
Direct request was denied by the public site, while the indexed official page described a document-based boundary service; no gated access was attempted.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if publicly returned
blocker: No public, anonymous, Shorsh/Kirkuk-scoped parcel geometry endpoint was identified after bounded first-party discovery. Exact-point absence was not used as evidence of citywide absence.
remainingUncertainty: A local Kirkuk registration office or non-indexed internal GIS may hold parcel maps. Title-specific, authenticated, owner-document, CAPTCHA, and private-token workflows were intentionally not accessed.
nextStep: If revisited, look for a documented public Kirkuk cadastral viewer or geometry-only export from the relevant registration directorate; validate CRS, geographic placement, parcel semantics and native IDs before any adapter consideration.
